rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken noun for a painted artwork.

example.english: This painting has a great atmosphere.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hou2 jau5 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this for the work of applying paint, especially to a building or other surface.

example.english: We have to do the painting on the house tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jiu3 bong1 gaan1 uk1 jau4 cat1

rows.note: Use this for painting considered as an art form rather than for one individual artwork.

example.english: They regard painting as a form of artistic expression.
example.traditional: 佢哋將繪畫視為一種藝術表達。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 kui2 waa2 si6 wai4 jat1 zung2 ngai6 seot6 biu2 daat6
